                  <jats:bold>With the exponential growth of log data in the digital age, the
need for effective and secure log management has become essential for
organizations. Conventional log storage systems are known to struggle
with challenges related to data security and privacy. As log files often
contain sensitive data, any leakage may result in security violations
and compliance issues. In this article, a Blockchain-based system is
proposed, integrating a RoBERTa- based sensitivity classifier with a
layered circled blockchain mechanism to ensure secure and efficient log
storage. The system begins with the aggregation of logs from local
systems, which are then processed using a pre-trained RoBERTa model to
determine their sensitivity. Non-sensitive logs are stored in the
Ethereum public blockchain to maintain transparency and permanence,
while sensitive logs are stored in a Hyperledger private network to
ensure confidentiality. A layered circled blockchain mechanism is
proposed to dynamically compute the optimal chain length for log
storage, facilitating the creation of terminal and progressive blocks.
The system is evaluated based on key performance indicators, including
chain length, transaction throughput (TPS), and log sensitivity
classification accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that log
security is enhanced and privacy-preserving storage is ensured, and
overall performance is improved.</jats:bold>
                </jats:p>"},{"DOI":"10.1201/9780203491768","title":["Audit and Trace Log Management"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2006,4,5]]},"type":"book"},{"DOI":"10.1109/tdsc.2025.3640696","title":["SAGA: Synthetic Audit Log Generation for APT Campaigns"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2026,3]]},"container-title":["IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing"],"type":"journal-article"},{"DOI":"10.32628/cseit26123344","title":["Secure File Integrity Audit System with Instant Notification Module"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2026,6,1]]},"container-title":["International Journal of Scientific Research in Computer Science, Engineering and Information Technology"],"type":"journal-article","abstract":"<jats:p>This system provides a Secure File Integrity Audit System complete with an Instant Notification Module that can be used to demonstrate that all digital files stored in Cloud can be safely and securely managed. As individuals and organizations rely on cloud-based storage solutions, it is important that the files that they save and access are safe from unauthorized access, tampering, and other forms of corruption. Therefore, this system provides the ability to securely manage files uploaded to the cloud and verify that they have not been altered or corrupted. When a user uploads a file, a SHA-256 hash value is generated that is unique to that file and acts as a digital fingerprint of that file to verify its integrity before and after use. The hashed values are saved in a secure location and used to determine whether they have been altered or corrupted at the time of file verification by comparing the original hash value with newly generated values at the time of verification. This system utilises a strong authentication mechanism to ensure that only the authorized user has access to the files uploaded to this cloud storage system. The system also incorporates an approval workflow process managed by the administrator, where files that have been uploaded will be reviewed by the administrator prior to being saved permanently. In addition to the above mentioned features, the system includes an instant email notification module to notify the administrators and users about their upload status, verification results and whether the uploaded files have been approved or rejected. Additionally, audit logs of all system activity will be generated to create an accurate record of all activity in the system from uploads to verifications to administrative activity, including when the events occur. Data Integrity Audit Aide Memoire"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2018]]},"container-title":["Data Integrity and Data Governance"],"type":"book-chapter"},{"DOI":"10.1201/9780203491768.fmatt","title":["The Author"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2006,4,5]]},"container-title":["Audit and Trace Log Management"],"type":"other"},{"DOI":"10.1002/sec.1242","title":["BAFi: a practical cryptographic secure audit logging scheme for digital forensics"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2015,3,26]]},"container-title":["Security and Communication Networks"],"type":"journal-article"},{"DOI":"10.1201/9781003642398-1","title":["The Helm of Integrity"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2026,4,1]]},"container-title":["Bridging the Gap"],"type":"book-chapter"},{"DOI":"10.21070/ups.850","title":["Audit Committee, Company Size, Audit Tenure, Intellectual Capital, and Earnings Management on the Integrity of Financial Statements"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2023,4,14]]},"type":"posted-content"},{"DOI":"10.48001/978-81-988770-4-8-1","title":["Audit Automation Using Artificial Intelligence"],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2025,7]]},"container-title":["The AI Audit: Accountability, Integrity, and the Future of Finance"],"type":"book-chapter","abstract":"<jats:p>The introduction of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is revolutionizing the processes of conducting financial, compliance, and operational audits. The sufficiency of traditional audit practices which involve the manual analysis of data and human-made judgments is increasingly becoming obsolete. The evolution of AI technologies enables smarter, faster and more scalable approaches to audit automation. In this chapter, I discuss the history and fundamentals of audit automation and how it is being transformed by AI technologies such as Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and other predictive analytic tools. ML empowers various processes with the ability to learn from historical data and identify anomalies and risk levels. NLP facilitates understanding of unstructured information including contracts and emails while RPA takes over standard and repetitive audit activities. Predictive analytics improves foresight in assessing future risks and compliance issues. With automation enabled through these technologies, auditors can concentrate on more prominent responsibilities boosting accuracy and reducing human errors. The chapter presents the challenges, advantages, and future of AI audits while explaining the ways in which businesses are able to leverage these technologies.</jats:p>"}],"items-per-page":25,"query":{"start-index":0,"search-terms":null}}}
